title: fix(metadata-protocol): migrate-stored re-saves a draft-only permission set granting on an object gone since
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9Cu6rc6Nw1Ty87DTpPRgFnW)_
Fixes #29279

Clause-②: yes (widening) — measured: base `a19759ac` reports the draft-only set `failed` (422 unknown-grant sentence); head reports it `rewritten`. Every author-facing door judges as on `main` (the two author pins below hold on both trees).
Metadata-protocol: none — measured: no key, value or type an author can write changes; the only accept-set change is a server-stated `source: 'migrate-stored'` re-save, which no client can claim (the REST layer never forwards `source`).

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：`os migrate meta --stored --apply`（以及 `POST /api/v1/meta/_migrate-stored`）重存一个只有草稿、需要转换（如去掉已退役的 `managedBy`）的权限集时，不再因为它授权的对象已经不存在而报 `failed`；发布该草稿时仍然会被拒。发布时的提示文字改成说明发布时查找的范围。
- **为什么改**：#28990 的「授权对象不存在」拒绝用权限集的已发布行判断「已持有的授权」，只有草稿的权限集没有已发布行，于是迁移自己的重存被拒，旧键留在库里。
- **风险与回滚**：低。只放行服务端自己声明的 `migrate-stored` 重存（客户端无法伪造 `source`），和旁边种子 `externalId` 规则（#28952）的豁免同一写法；作者的保存、发布、回滚判定不变。回滚即撤回本 PR。
- **先看**：`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`（`saveMetaItem` 里 #28990 块加了 `writeSource !== 'migrate-stored'`；发布路径传 `'publish'`）；`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-save-door-refusals.ts`（提示文字分两种门）；`packages/objectql/src/protocol-migrate-stored-draft-permission-grant.test.ts`（真内核用例）。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol exec vitest run src/protocol.unknown-grant-object-refusal.test.ts`，预期 18/18 通过（新增的 `[#29279]` 两条在内）。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **Fix 1 (behaviour).** The `unknownGrantObjectSaveRefusal` call in `saveMetaItem` is skipped for a `migrate-stored` re-save, copying the #28952 precedent beside it (`seedExternalIdSaveRefusal`'s `writeSource !== 'migrate-stored'`). Chosen over "read the held keys from the draft row" because it keeps every other door judged exactly as on `main`: `writeSource` is server-stated (only `migrateStoredMetadata` sets it), the publish promotion and the restore doors do not pass through this branch, and the draft is still judged at its publish. Reading the draft row instead would also have widened an author's draft re-save of a draft-only set (its held keys would come from the draft), which the card rules out.
- **Fix 2 (wording).** At `promoteDraftForPublish` the finding now reads "…which is not defined in objects: no package registers an object of that name, and no published object, or object draft of this batch, carries it, so the grant applies to nothing." The save door and the restore doors keep "…and none is saved here…". The path (`objects.NAME`) and the leading "Permission 'SET' grants on object 'NAME' which is not defined in objects" (the sentence family `defineStack` and Studio key on) are unchanged. Implemented as a `door: 'save' | 'publish'` parameter (default `'save'`) on the refusal; only the promotion passes `'publish'`.
- **Fix 3 (changeset).** `.changeset/29279-migrate-stored-draft-permission-grant.md` (patch) says a draft stored before the rule is refused at its publish, as `26724-object-unknown-datasource-refused.md` does. The pending #28990 changeset is not edited.
- Docblocks of `unknownGrantObjectSaveRefusal` (protocol.ts) updated: the "stored-row migration … is not judged" bullet now sits under the carve-out, which is what makes it true for a draft-only set.

## Tests

- New real-kernel file `packages/objectql/src/protocol-migrate-stored-draft-permission-grant.test.ts` (`ObjectKernel` + `ObjectQLPlugin`, in-memory driver copied from `protocol-duplicate-package-objects-key-collision.test.ts`): an object draft and a set draft granting on it, the set's stored body given the retired `managedBy` key, the object draft removed. The measured case (→ `rewritten`, key stripped, grant kept, still a draft), its publish still refused, the control with the object draft present (→ `rewritten`), and an author's draft re-save still refused.
- `protocol.unknown-grant-object-refusal.test.ts`: new `[#29279]` describe (the pass rewrites a planted draft-only set; its publish is refused; an author re-save is refused).
- **Forced test edit:** the same file's three publish-path assertions (`publishMetaItem` ×2, `publishPackageDrafts`) now expect the publish wording; `unknownFinding`/`expectRefusal` take a `door` argument. The `publishPackageDrafts` case now asserts the whole first sentence instead of the `grants on object` fragment.

## Acceptance notes

- The premise test needed the planted row's `checksum` cleared: a row whose stored stamp equals the converted body's hash is a no-op write (`storedBodyUnchanged`), so planting the key under the old stamp made the control read `rewritten` while writing nothing. A row really stored with the key carries its own stamp. Noted, not a defect.

## Verification

All readings at head `f7ee536e` unless marked.
